description: Keep commit messages tidy by checking them before each commit.

# Commit tidy

Use this when the user asks for cleaner commit messages.

1. Ask which repository to set up. Show the user the commit-message check script bundled with this skill so they can read it.
2. After they agree, copy that fixed script into that one repository's own hooks folder (not the user-level git config). Do not change hooks in any other repository and do not fetch updates.
3. Reply with what was added and how to remove it (delete that one hook file).
